en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a lakeside park scene. In the foreground is a pond or small lake surrounded by dense trees. On a small peninsula or island stands a neoclassical round pavilion with a domed roof and columns. On the right edge there are multi-story villas or spa buildings with balconies. In the background are rolling wooded hills and a small town. At the top of the postcard, printed text reads the place name and the specific site.
